function.name: project_api_ProjectApi_update_project
function.description: This method updates the existing project details with the given information. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

project_id.description: The unique identifier for the project to be updated.

name.description: The new name of the project.

description.description: The new description of the project.

status.description: The current status of the project.

due_date.description: The updated due date for the project completion in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

project_data.description: A dictionary containing the new data for the project.

function.name: version_api_VersionApi_get_version
function.description: Retrieve the current version information of the application, including the application name and its version number. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: project_api_ProjectApi_get_project_by_name_and_version
function.description: Retrieve the details of a specific project using its name and version as identifiers. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.
